findings.message: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING has no explicit conflict target — PostgreSQL cannot resolve the partial index uq_reward_wallets_individual without ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT or explicit column list
findings.manualAction: Change to ON CONFLICT (client_id, user_id, currency_id) WHERE wallet_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' DO NOTHING to explicitly target the partial index

findings.message: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING has no explicit conflict target — cannot resolve partial indexes uq_budget_util_global / uq_budget_util_location without explicit column list
findings.manualAction: Add explicit ON CONFLICT (incentive_id, currency_id) WHERE location_value_id IS NULL DO NOTHING for global rows, and ON CONFLICT (incentive_id, currency_id, location_value_id) DO NOTHING for location rows

findings.message: Advisory lock keyed on (incentiveId:userId) does not protect per-partner cap — concurrent grants by different users for the same partner+incentive can still race
findings.manualAction: Consider also acquiring pg_advisory_xact_lock on (incentiveId:partnerCompanyId) when partnerCompanyId is non-null, or add a SELECT FOR UPDATE on a partner-cap sentinel row

findings.message: acquireGrantLock @Modifying missing flushAutomatically=true — unflushed Hibernate state may not be visible to subsequent native queries in the same transaction
No null-guard on request.incentiveId() / request.userId() before lock key concatenation — NullPointerException if either is null
IllegalStateException message includes only clientId — missing userId and currencyId, making diagnosis difficult
hashtext() produces a 32-bit hash — collision probability non-trivial at scale for distinct (incentiveId:userId) pairs
findings.manualAction: Use pg_advisory_xact_lock(bigint, bigint) with two separate hashtext() calls, or use ('x' || md5(:lockKey))::bit(64)::bigint for 64-bit hash

findings.message: hasRole() reads SecurityContextHolder — may hold wrong principal in async contexts
AccessDeniedException throws not logged — financial access denials should be recorded for audit
findings.manualAction: Add log.warn() before each AccessDeniedException throw

contract-compliance.notes: Not invalidated: no controller/DTO files changed. All 3 endpoints match contract.

findings.summary: Per-user and per-partner cap SUM queries executed without row-level lock — RESOLVED: pg_advisory_xact_lock on (incentiveId:userId) at top of grantReward() serializes concurrent grants for same user+incentive before any cap reads
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — acquireGrantLock() added at top of grantReward(); advisory lock is transaction-scoped and prevents cap-check race for same user+incentive

findings.summary: creditInCurrentTx() wallet auto-creation via orElseGet() had no retry — RESOLVED: replaced with ensureIndividualWalletExists() (INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) + findForUpdate(); race eliminated at DB level
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — ensureIndividualWalletExists() added to RewardWalletRepository; creditInCurrentTx() now uses ensureExists + findForUpdate pattern

findings.summary: grantReward() calls creditInCurrentTx(awarded=ZERO) when fully capped — creates zero-amount ledger entries
findings.recommendation: Add early return when awarded <= 0 before creating the RewardTransaction and calling creditInCurrentTx.

findings.summary: Per-partner cap race across different users for the same partner+incentive — advisory lock only serializes per (incentiveId:userId), not per (incentiveId:partnerCompanyId)
findings.tierReason: confidence=0.65 (< 0.70) — advisory; requires concurrent different-user grants under same partner, low probability in current traffic patterns
findings.recommendation: Add a second pg_advisory_xact_lock on (incentiveId:partnerCompanyId) when partnerCompanyId is non-null.

findings.summary: hasRole() reads SecurityContextHolder which may hold wrong principal in async contexts

classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled=true
